en.answer: After the second effect of <<11518>> has been activated once this turn, as long as your opponent has at least 1 card on their side of the field, and <<11518>> still has a Fusion, Synchro, and Xyz Monster as Xyz Materials, its effect can be activated a second time this turn.
en.question: Can the second effect of <<11518>> be activated more than once per turn?
en.title: Can the second effect of <<11518>> be activated more than once per turn?
